steps.objective: Propose the strongest 'stay within the current system' architecture for a Confinement Authority component in fgOS dispatch at /home/vantt/projects/forgentX. REAL FINDINGS FROM THIS SESSION'S OWN SCOUT PASSES (trust these, they are cited call-site facts, not guesses): (A) No Confinement Authority component exists today. Confinement is pure argv: /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/.fgos/config.json's claude-bwrap/agy-bwrap executors (lines 175-245) hardcode an identical 9-token `bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc --bind <abs>/.fgos/assignments <abs>/.fgos/assignments -- <cli> ...` prologue, duplicated by copy-paste including a machine-specific absolute path; codex-readonly (lines 246-266) expresses the same read-only INTENT via a completely different mechanism (`codex exec -s read-only`), and nothing in the schema says these three are the same class. (B) A second, fully disconnected confinement scheme already exists: /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/src/runner/dispatch/config.mjs declares a `confinement` object with flags `privateHome`/`isolatedSession`/`ownWorktree` (line 696, validated 713-775), enforced only inside /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/src/runner/dispatch/herdr-round.mjs's `establishConfinement` (lines 209-253) for the `herdr-spawn` adapter -- zero code connects it to the bwrap executors. (C) DECISIVE: /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/src/runner/dispatch/transport.mjs's `resolveExecutorCommand` (line 145) -- the ONE real funnel that assembles argv for every out-of-process dispatch -- has NO `mutation`/read-only-posture parameter in its signature at all. Confinement selection today is driven ENTIRELY by which executor config gets resolved (resolve.mjs's `resolveExecutorConfig`/`capabilities.<name>.prefer`, lines 282-307) -- a human-typed binding. An Assignment's stamped `mutation` posture (from assignment-normalizer.mjs) is real and mostly-reliable when an Assignment exists, but it is NEVER forwarded to argv assembly, and `spawnWorker`'s dominant real call path (/home/vantt/projects/forgentX/src/runner/loop.mjs:1005, the main fgos-runner per-item dispatch loop) has NO Assignment at all -- so a design keyed on Assignment.mutation would silently not apply on the busiest real dispatch path. The only input reliably in scope on EVERY real path is the resolved executorId/config itself. (D) Known live defect: `providerModel` inference breaks when `command` becomes `bwrap` (claude-bwrap must declare `providerModel: 'claude'` explicitly because `deriveProviderFamily` matches the literal command string) -- confirmed live during a prior real session (tsk-1o4/P05.2). Any design where confinement rewrites the executor's own `command` field re-creates this exact leak. (E) Reversibility already split by the lead-advisor's interpretation: green/additive = a ConfinementProfile concept + backend abstraction that emits today's byte-identical argv (provably behavior-preserving); amber/migratory = deduplicating the two copy-pasted bwrap prologues and fixing the hardcoded absolute `.fgos/assignments` path (a real portability defect on any non-`/home/vantt` checkout); red/breaking = retiring the executor NAMES `claude-bwrap`/`agy-bwrap`/`codex-readonly`, which are load-bearing in `capabilities.advise`/`code:review`/`code:debug` and in the tsk-1o4 falsification-evidence trail. YOUR TASK: propose ONE concrete architecture answering all six of the person's own sub-asks: (1) component boundary -- what it owns vs. not (vs. the existing worktree isolation guard [git branch/write-serialization, NOT a sandbox -- /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/src/runner/worktree.mjs explicitly states a SAME-USER TRUST INVARIANT, lines 7-11] and main-checkout lock [write-serialization only, /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/src/runner/main-checkout-lock.mjs:375-438]); (2) component parent -- exactly which existing module it lives under/beside, given finding (C); (3) canonical contracts -- the real input/output shape at the real seam you identify; (4) backend abstraction -- an interface covering at minimum the two live, non-substitutable mechanisms already proven (bwrap OS mount, provider-native `-s read-only`), and state whether the disconnected herdr-round.mjs confinement scheme (finding B) should become a third backend or stay separate, with your reasoning; (5) a default implementation simple enough to ship now (KISS/YAGNI) that provably preserves today's exact argv output for the three existing executors; (6) an expansion roadmap ordered by the green/amber/red reversibility split in finding (E). State the falsification criteria that would prove your proposal wrong BEFORE any critique -- name a condition that could actually occur and that the panel could observe, not falsification theatre.
